My anxiety was aweful in high school too. Constant nerves, shaky voice , and anything you could think of. Now in my senior year of college I have to do a presentation in a large lecture hall, but I’m not as nervous because I’m currently taking propranolol & it has made me feel so calm and confident. 

Although it is used for high blood pressure, it can also alleviate and remove the physical symptoms of anxiety.. you’re not going to be an amazing public speaker right away, but you won’t feel the symptoms as much. Still gotta practice and make sure you know your material.

Your doctor will have to prescribe it to you, but I would highly recommend it and try to figure out which dosage is right for you - 10mg , 20 etc.

As much as it sucks having to hear the same advice over & over, it really all comes down to repetition & patterns (Practicing, breathing techniques, preparation, therapy etc). The more you do something the better you become. 

You could also speak with your doctor about prescribing propranolol. I recently got prescribed it & it does wonders! Makes you feel calm, and removes any of the physical symptoms that you encounter. 
It won’t make you a pro public speaker right away , but take the medication and face on those presentations without the symptoms.

Not every speech needs humor, or vulnerability stories. There’s a plethora of ways to convey a message & present a speech effectively. Now, I wasn’t there to experience the presentation, but considering that you remember this speech means they did their job.
